name: labs/karimrayttu__ece-tool-suite
title: ECE Tool Suite oscilloscope (ece_suite.instruments.keysight.KeysightScope)
intro: ECE Tool Suite oscilloscope (ece_suite.instruments.keysight.KeysightScope), adapted from karimrayttu/ece-tool-suite. It reads `identity` and `measurements`; runs `measure_item`, `measure_vpp`, `capture`, `run` and 3 more. `measure_item`: read one scalar automatic measurement from the scope's current measurement set. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
